scope: EXPERIMENTAL structured satellite-data verifier. Trained and evaluated on firms_labels_v2.csv (live-v1 VIIRS features only). NOT a validated Algerian wildfire detector: the labels contain NO independently confirmed southern Algerian wildfire positive, and the negative class is predominantly catalogued gas flare (N1-flare). Do not claim coverage of all Algerian wildfires, national validation, or universal wildfire-vs-flare separation.

model_selection.rule: highest validation F1, tie-break validation PR-AUC

uncertainty_band.rule: candidate margins are quantiles of the validation NON-FIRE score distribution; choose the one whose validation review share is closest to the pre-declared review budget (10%), tie-broken on higher non-fire recall
uncertainty_band.interpretation: operating margin selected on validation data; it is a review-workload decision, not a calibrated probability-of-truth statement
